symptom: MPR007's home-page warning said a user role 'cannot open' its home page and that 'mxbuild reports CE2729 for each widget on it' on a project at Prototype security, where `mx check` reports zero CE2729 and the role opens the page fine (HTTP 200, no banner) — only the data and actions it lacks access to are withheld (ako/mxcli-rest FINDINGS #68)
cause: The message was written from the one project that motivated the check (ChipCoV6, Production security). CE2729 is an entity-access error, and only Production (CheckEverything) checks entity access, so the consequence was level-dependent while the message stated it unconditionally
insight: A lint message has two halves: the model fact (no module role of the user role is granted the page — true at every level) and the consequence (level-dependent). Measure the consequence at each level the rule fires at before naming a CE number; the rest project's `playwright check --role User --fresh-login` is what separated the two
